title: Spinel: A Post-Quantum Signature Scheme Based on $\mathrm{SL}_n(\mathbb{F}_p)$ Hashing
summary: The advent of quantum computation compels the cryptographic community to design digital signature schemes whose security extends beyond the classical hardness assumptions. In this work, we introduce Spinel, a post-quantum digital signature scheme that combines the proven security of SPHINCS+ (CCS 2019) with a new family of algebraic hash functions (Adv. Math. Commun. 2025) derived from the Tillich-Zemor paradigm (Eurocrypt 2008) with security rooted in the hardness of navigating expander graphs over $\mathrm{SL}_n(\mathbb{F}_p)$, a problem believed to be hard even for quantum adversaries.
